verdict.summary: Flagship Kazakh development bank (owned via Baiterek Holding) equalized with Kazakhstan's IG sovereign (Moody's Baa1 / Fitch BBB / S&P BBB). FY25 assets surged 36% to KZT 7.67tn with KZT 1.13tn equity and KZT 111.4bn profit, while impaired loans dropped to 6% in 1Q26 (from 9% YE24). Deep multi-currency market access across USD, KZT, and CNH.

positives: Sovereign-equalized IG ratings (Baa1 / BBB / BBB) backed by Baiterek / Republic of Kazakhstan.
Impaired loans reduced to 6% in 1Q26 (from 9% YE24) alongside KZT 1.13tn equity base (authorized capital KZT 826bn).
Strong multi-currency funding franchise (USD $900m 2030s, $500m 2031s, KZT 230bn-300bn Eurobonds).
negatives: Rapid 47% FY25 financing growth and elevated 18% Stage 2 exposure concentration.
Project-finance lumpy credit risk in non-oil industrial diversification mandates.
KZT/USD currency mismatch risk on unhedged domestic industrial borrowers.

background.business_overview: Kazakhstan's sole state development bank financing long-term non-extractive industrial, infrastructure, and energy projects.
background.asset_perimeter: Corporate/project loan & leasing portfolio across Kazakhstan; subsidiary Baiterek National Managing Holding.
background.ownership_governance: 100% state-owned via Baiterek NMH; KASE/LSE-listed debt.
